name: Boundless Trailbreaker
text:
Trample, haste
Whenever Boundless Trailbreaker enters the battlefield or attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal five land cards. Put all land cards revealed this way onto the battlefield tapped, then untap all lands you control. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase. This ability triggers only once each turn.
